sources.title: PDF Skin Disease Detection Using Ensemble Learning
sources.snippet: However, the process of diagnosing skin conditions often requires specialized dermatological expertise, which can be time-consuming and expensive. To address this challenge, we have developed a web-based Skin Disease Detection System using cutting-edge machine learning and ensemble techniques.
